correctness.rationale: The steady flux identity, map elimination, centered elliptic energy identity, covariance sign/Lipschitz estimate, Neumann Poincare step, and sharp saturating-law threshold match were checked analytically, including both signs of the coupling and the alpha=0 case.

originality.rationale: The motivating 2026 paper gives local stability and bifurcation thresholds in the no-growth case; the inspected recent review and synonymous searches did not expose the global logarithmic-slope obstruction or its sharp saturating-law consequence. Residual literature risk is documented in REVIEW.md.

value.rationale: The result globally excludes arbitrary-amplitude positive stationary patterns in an explicit region and, for an admissible saturating memory law, reaches exactly the first local bifurcation threshold from the stable side.
